common.demoBanner: Demo mode: the app is running without external API keys. Some data is estimated.

home.heroTitle: From a dream to a day-by-day plan, in 3 minutes
home.heroSubtitle: Answer a short questionnaire and Triplan builds your trip day by day and hour by hour, fitted to your pace, ages, transport and opening hours.

fit.title: Fitted to who travels
fit.body: A family with a baby, a couple in their 70s, or sporty travelers on their third visit: every plan is built from scratch for the people going.

honest.title: Transparent and honest
honest.body: Every placement has a reason: "12 minutes walk from the hotel", "open on Saturday". Whatever is unverified is marked.

offline.title: Works in the field
offline.body: The plan, the map and the addresses work without internet, on your phone, like an app.

1.title: Answer 10 questions
1.body: Destination, dates, who travels, pace, transport, budget and hotel. Every question has a smart default.

2.title: Get a plan
2.body: Day by day, hour by hour, with walking distance, a rain plan and alternatives.

3.title: Edit and go
3.body: Drag, swap, lock. Export to PDF and calendar, and share with your travel partners.

home.statusBody: Triplan is built in phases. Current phase: foundation. The questionnaire and the planning engine are on the way.

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.intro: Triplan shows links to external booking sites: hotels, attraction tickets and flights.
disclosure.affiliate: Some of these links are affiliate links. If you book through them, Triplan may earn a small commission. Your price does not change.
disclosure.marking: Every such link is labeled "Affiliate link" in the interface and opens in a new tab.
disclosure.data: Attraction data that has not been verified is labeled "unverified". Check opening hours and prices before you go.
disclosure.noKeys: There are currently no active affiliate keys, and the links are plain search links.

footer.madeWith: Built on open maps and free data
